object.name: DroneCANESCCommand
object.description: Bench control of DroneCAN ESCs. While Enabled, the DroneCAN module broadcasts uavcan.equipment.esc.RawCommand (data type 1030) carrying the first Count values of Command at Rate Hz (50 when 0). Raw units: 0 stops, 8191 is full throttle, negative reverses on bidirectional ESCs. Arm selects what the accompanying uavcan.equipment.safety.ArmingStatus (1100, 10 Hz) says: AM32 ESCs run only while they hear FULLY_ARMED (their REQUIRE_ARMING default). If nobody refreshes the object for 2 s the module sends zeros instead. Not the flight path: the actuator module does not use this.
